terms.body:
miniHome Terms of Use (Portfolio Sample)

miniHome is a portfolio project that demonstrates smart-home UI and application architecture. Devices, actions, and account data shown in the app are for demonstration only and do not control real products or services.

This sample is provided for UI demonstration and is not a legal agreement for a production service.

privacy.body:
Privacy Policy (Portfolio Sample)

miniHome handles only the information needed for the portfolio demo. API keys, credentials, and personal information are not stored in the public repository.

This sample is provided for UI demonstration and is not a legal document for a production service.

faq.body:
Frequently Asked Questions

Q. Can miniHome control real lights or air conditioners?
A. Not yet. The current MVP uses a Mockoon API for demonstration.

Q. Which devices are supported?
A. The demo focuses on smart lights and air conditioners.

Q. Where is data stored?
A. The MVP uses mock API data. Firebase Auth and Firestore are planned as a later migration.
